model.fit_policy: Median of four normalized manual rectangle boundaries on odd24; no brightness/color used in fitting. Replaces inscribed disk, which threw away valid rectangle corners and sometimes could not hold a3x3 patch. Single final rectangle; trial1 kept. Geometry-only one refinement; no threshold adjustment or parameter sweep.
